item.description:
Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Remind me if no reply. When writing a message, use the bell next to Send Later to pick Tomorrow, In 3 Days or In 1 Week. If nobody has answered by then, the conversation comes back to the top of your Inbox with a notification. Out-of-office replies don't count as an answer.
  • Needs Reply. A new sidebar item lists recent Inbox mail where someone asked you something directly and you haven't answered yet. It works entirely on your Mac.
  • ⌘K command bar. Press ⌘K to jump to any mailbox or label, write to or find mail from a person, run any menu command, or search your mail.
  • Translate. Message › Translate translates a message on your Mac, and mail in another language offers a Translate button.
  • Tools in the sidebar. Contacts, Subscriptions, Attachments and New Senders are now grouped under Tools, which you can collapse. Right-click Tools to move the group up or down. Moving it by dragging is still being tested and may not work yet.
  • New Senders now looks and works like Subscriptions: search, contact photos, and click a sender to open their latest email.

Improvements

  • The Compose button stands apart from the message buttons in the toolbar.
  • The sidebar button sits at the sidebar's edge, as in Mail.
  • Shorter, tidier tooltips in Subscriptions.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed a crash that could happen when a tooltip appeared. Tooltips look the same as before.
  • Fixed a possible crash while the new-mail banner at the notch was animating.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed a crash that could happen while a tooltip or the new-mail notch banner was on screen.
  • Fixed a brief freeze caused by tooltips when the Mac was busy.
